params.prompt:
Create an EPIC 5-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

BOUNCER — NOT ON THE LIST.
Preserve the exact muscular bald Black man with close dark beard, gold chain and pendant, earpiece/radio, black SECURITY tactical vest, gloves, utility cargo trousers and heavy black boots, with the existing gold fist emblems. Preserve SECURITY as an existing costume marking; move title is the only additional text.
0–0.7s: complete full-body view, he raises the broad stop palm with an utterly unimpressed stare. Two finite gold rope-post props with a red velvet rope stand beside him against cyan.
0.7–2.4s: a giant red-gold energy fist emblem rushes toward the entrance. He casually catches its momentum on a MASSIVE translucent gold palm-shaped shield, then sweeps that palm sideways in one decisive ejection. Camera rockets along the trajectory as the emblem hurtles far into the distance, stretching the velvet rope into an enormous elastic arc before the rope SNAPS it through a tiny freestanding door outline. Huge localized gold-white impact star and heavy hold; no human target, no club interior or visible ground.
2.4–3.5s: SNAP-PUSH back to his stone-faced expression as exact title "NOT ON THE LIST" slams in two large comic lines beside his stop hand.
3.5–5s: he calmly clips the velvet rope back onto its post, taps his earpiece once and folds his arms. The tiny door closes far behind with a delayed little click. Hold complete imposing silhouette and title. Sound: incoming rush, huge palm stop, elastic rope whip and ejection boom, title slam, calm metal clasp and distant door click. No speech or music. Five seconds total.

BREAK — FLOOR SWEEP.
Preserve the exact illustrated athletic adult woman: short swept black hair, hoop earrings, open royal-blue track jacket and loose matching trousers with white stripes, black crop top, fingerless black gloves, black knee pads, blue-white high-top sneakers. Keep the costume cobalt-blue.
0–0.7s: full-body low stance, one gloved palm plants while she coils an extended leg underneath herself; confident competitive smile.
0.7–2.4s: she performs one whip-fast traveling circular leg sweep, the extended sneaker carving an ENORMOUS crescent of gold-and-ivory energy. Camera skims low alongside the shoe, then pulls wide as the crescent rolls outward like a gigantic curling wave carrying loose ink fragments away. She slides cleanly through the opening into a sharp one-knee finish; one luminous shoe-print sigil remains behind at the original spot, matching the ability's lasting mark. No floor plane, scene or other person; complete finite shoe-print graphic floats against cyan. Strongest impact is the wave snapping outward, with a brief hold and strong anatomy.
2.4–3.5s: camera whips toward her confident face and upright knee as exact title "FLOOR SWEEP" slams diagonally into two clear comic lines.
3.5–5s: she lightly dusts one glove off, taps the finishing sneaker once and gives a competitive grin while the distant shoe-print pulses. Clear asymmetrical dance finish, not a windmill or headspin. Sound: cloth windup, fast low sweeping whoosh, huge wave snap, title slam, final sneaker tap. No dialogue or music. Five seconds total.

COLOGNE CRIMINAL — YOU CAN STILL SMELL HIM.
Preserve the exact bizarre illustrated character: muscular brown human body, bare chest under an open taupe fur-trimmed coat, dark trousers and heavy black lace-up boots; his HEAD is a large translucent rectangular perfume bottle with a spray nozzle and drawn weary cartoon face. Preserve the bottle head and cartoon eyes/mouth; never replace it with a human head. Keep the bottle visible with ink outlines and ivory/lavender glass highlights, not cyan glow.
0–1.2s: establish full body. He straightens his fur collar, gives a weary suave look with the bottle's drawn face, then reaches up and presses his own spray nozzle once.
1.2–3.2s: that single spray becomes a colossal ribbon of gold-and-lavender perfume, curling upward into an enormous sculpted scent plume shaped like a swaggering coat silhouette. Camera rockets backward to reveal the impossible scale. The plume is finite ink-edged spirals and mist ribbons with cyan gaps, never a solid smoke backdrop or second physical character.
3.2–4.8s: he strides away from his original position. The gigantic scent silhouette STAYS BEHIND, then flexes outward into a huge flower-like blast of perfume curls and amber sparks, selling an effect that keeps dominating after he leaves. Camera tracks him moving forward while the lingering burst remains visibly distant. Brief impact hold on the scent expansion.
4.8–6s: SNAP-PUSH to his expressive bottle face as exact title "YOU CAN STILL SMELL HIM" slams in three bold readable lines beside him.
6–8s: camera eases back; he adjusts one cuff and tries to look dignified, but the nozzle gives one tiny delayed spritz. His drawn eyes shift upward in embarrassment while the huge persistent scent curls still hang behind. Hold title and character. Sound: collar rustle, atomizer click, gigantic spray rush, lingering plume boom, title slam, comically tiny late spritz. No dialogue or music.

CORRUPT PASTOR — COLLECTION PLATE.
Preserve the exact fictional illustrated adult preacher: close-cropped hair and goatee, dark sunglasses, black clerical outfit with white collar, long purple-and-gold embroidered stole, purple trousers, black patent loafers, heavy gold chains and cross pendant, gold rings/watch, black gold-edged book. Replace small crown motifs on buckle/shoes with gold fist emblems; keep religious crosses and other outfit identity intact. Satirical individual character, no congregation or real person.
0–1.2s: full body; he opens the book with theatrical gravitas and extends one ornate golden collection plate from beneath its cover, holding it perfectly level.
1.2–3.2s: the plate begins spinning on one fingertip like a huge carnival disk. Camera pulls far back as streams of abstract gold power coins spiral in from three directions, forming an ENORMOUS funnel above the plate. No currency details or actual donation instructions, just magical game tokens.
3.2–4.8s: he sharply closes the book. The entire swirling token funnel SLAMS down into the plate in one thunderous golden flash confined to a huge ink-outlined sunburst. The plate temporarily swells to absurd size; his gold accessories flare with power and his robe billows, while his body remains the same person and proportions. Leave clean cyan around the finite effect.
4.8–6s: camera SNAP-PUSHES to his pleased face and reflective sunglasses as exact title "COLLECTION PLATE" stamps into two big comic lines.
6–8s: he secretly tilts the overflowing plate into the open book; the coins pour between its pages and vanish. He snaps the book shut, hugs it close and assumes an exaggerated innocent expression as one last coin drops into his hand. Camera eases to a readable hero composition. Sound: book open, plate spin, accelerating coin cascade, enormous collection impact, title stamp, book clap and final coin ping. No sermon, speech, choir or music.
